description:
Talk to your menu like you talk to your team.

With Butterfly in ChatGPT, you can check what guests are viewing, see which dishes are getting attention, track scans and orders, and understand what is working. You can also update prices, manage opening hours, create promotions, control offer-wheel discounts, and translate dishes—all through a simple conversation.

defaultPrompt: Show my menu and my most selling dish
Show my restaurant overview for the last 30 days — scans, AR opens, and orders.
I want to create a discount/wheel spin offer; what’s the best dish?
